items.text: ¿Cuánto vendimos en total el último trimestre?
items.sql: SELECT round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

items.text: ¿Qué sucursal vendió más el último trimestre?
items.sql: SELECT branch AS sucursal, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY branch ORDER BY ventas DESC LIMIT 1

items.text: Ventas por sucursal en el último trimestre
items.sql: SELECT branch AS sucursal, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY branch ORDER BY ventas DESC

items.text: ¿Cuánto crecieron las ventas del último trimestre frente al mismo trimestre del año pasado?
items.sql: SELECT round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'), 2) AS ventas, round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'), 2) AS ventas_anterior FROM {sales}

items.text: Ventas por mes en 2026
items.sql: SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

items.text: ¿En qué mes vendimos más?
items.sql: SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} GROUP BY mes ORDER BY ventas DESC LIMIT 1

items.text: Los 5 productos que más vendieron el último trimestre
items.sql: SELECT product AS producto, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY product ORDER BY ventas DESC LIMIT 5

items.text: Ventas por categoría en los últimos 6 meses
items.sql: SELECT category AS categoria, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY category ORDER BY ventas DESC

items.text: Unidades vendidas de Snacks por mes en 2026
items.sql: SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, sum(units) AS unidades FROM {sales} WHERE category = 'Snacks' AND date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

items.text: ¿Cuántas facturas emitió la sucursal Centro en septiembre de 2026?
items.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice) AS facturas FROM {sales} WHERE branch = 'Centro' AND date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

items.text: Ticket promedio por sucursal el último trimestre
items.sql: SELECT branch AS sucursal, round(sum(total) / count(DISTINCT invoice), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY branch ORDER BY ticket_promedio DESC

items.text: Ventas por categoría del último trimestre comparadas con el trimestre anterior
items.sql: SELECT category AS categoria, round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'), 2) AS ventas, round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'), 2) AS ventas_anterior FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY category ORDER BY ventas DESC

items.text: ¿Cómo le fue a Las Colinas el último trimestre comparado con el trimestre anterior?
items.sql: SELECT round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'), 2) AS ventas, round(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'), 2) AS ventas_anterior FROM {sales} WHERE branch = 'Las Colinas'

items.text: Ventas de Bebidas y Lácteos por sucursal en agosto de 2026
items.sql: SELECT branch AS sucursal, category AS categoria, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE category IN ('Bebidas', 'Lácteos') AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY branch, category ORDER BY sucursal, categoria

items.text: ¿Cuántas unidades vendimos en 2025?
items.sql: SELECT sum(units) AS unidades FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

items.text: ¿Cuál fue el producto más vendido en unidades en diciembre de 2025?
items.sql: SELECT product AS producto, sum(units) AS unidades FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 1

items.text: Ventas por trimestre
items.sql: SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS trimestre, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} GROUP BY trimestre ORDER BY trimestre

items.text: Ventas de la sucursal Centro sin contar Limpieza en el último trimestre
items.sql: SELECT round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE branch = 'Centro' AND category <> 'Limpieza' AND date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

items.text: Las 3 categorías que menos vendieron en 2026
items.sql: SELECT category AS categoria, round(sum(total), 2) AS ventas FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY category ORDER BY ventas ASC LIMIT 3

items.text: Ticket promedio por mes en los últimos 6 meses
items.sql: SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes, round(sum(total) / count(DISTINCT invoice), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM {sales} WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes
